project.name: Inspecto — Operational Event Viewer (Standard edition, optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL Standard-edition events feed (EDITIONS.md CP-13, second half): the whole /events* surface — recent/live-tail, filtered search, by-id, CSV-or-JSON export incl. the audit-shaped CSV, and saved filter views — contributed through the core's public com.gamma.control.RouteModule ServiceLoader seam.
WHY THE WHOLE FEED (EDG-01 cell 6, 2026-09-07, operator decision). Cell 5 gated only the /metrics EXPOSITION, leaving CP-13 half true: the events feed and the audit CSV export still shipped in every bundle. The operator's call was to move the feed WHOLE rather than gate the export alone, because the audit CSV is not a route -- it is a ?format=csv&type=AUDIT branch INSIDE GET /events/export, so gating it alone would mean an `if` inside a core route, which is precisely the mechanism EDITIONS Assembly bans.
⚠ Accept what that costs: Personal loses the Events SCREEN, not just an endpoint nobody browses. The core answers every /events* path with 503 naming this module (AbsentEventsRoutes), /bootstrap reports features.events=false, the UI drops the nav entry, and the Ops lens home falls back to pipelines -- otherwise an Ops user on Personal would land on a dead screen.
⚠ Only the HTTP SURFACE moves. EventStore/EventLog/EventQuery stay in inspecto-event: events are still RECORDED in every edition (the audit trail is a compliance obligation, not a feature), and AuditTrailTest still proves that on Personal. What Personal loses is the ability to READ the feed back over HTTP.
Built only under the "edition-standard"/"edition-enterprise" profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal, the DEFAULT build) never compiles it.
